description: Data transmitted between systems, services, or networks is not encrypted. This signal indicates that sensitive information may be exposed to interception or eavesdropping during transmission over network connections.
applicability: Applicable to any network communication including API calls, database connections, file transfers, email, and internal service communication. Includes both external-facing and internal network traffic.

metadata.detection_notes: Detected through network traffic analysis, protocol inspection, TLS configuration review, and service endpoint configuration analysis. May involve checking for HTTP vs HTTPS, unencrypted database connections, or plaintext protocols.
